description:
FILED s448p (agent P) from the #570 probes; PRE-EXISTING, LOUD (a whole-file
transpile failure, not a silent wrong, and not a statement drop).

REPRO (perl vs ./runpcl) â all three fail the FILE:
  sub f7 { my (undef) = @_; return defined($_[0]) ? "def" : "undef" }
  print f7(qw(A B));                      # perl: def
  ---
  my (undef) = (1,2); print "ok\n";       # perl: ok
  ---
  sub g { my (undef, undef) = @_; "g" }   # perl: g
  print g(1,2);

  PCL (all three):
    Transpile failed:
    Parser2 TODO: unsupported declaration: my (undef) = @_; at Pl/Parser2.pm line 7969.

  The MIXED list is fine â `my (undef, $x) = @_` works (that is #570, fixed in
  s448p) â so the refusal is exactly "the list declares NO variable at all".

CAUSE (located): Pl::Parser2::_multi_decl (Pl/Parser2.pm ~10469) builds @vars by
grepping the Symbol tokens out of the Structure::List and then
    return () if !@vars || grep { !/^[\$\@\%]\w+$/ } @vars;
An all-placeholder list has NO symbols, so it returns the empty list and
_lower_block's `die "Parser2 TODO: unsupported declaration: ..."` (Pl/Parser2.pm
~7969) takes the whole file.  `_is_empty_my_decl` (the `my ();` no-op, task
#227) runs just BEFORE it and does not match â the list is not empty, it just
declares nothing.

WHAT PERL DOES: `my (undef) = LIST` declares nothing and evaluates LIST in list
context, discarding it; it is a legal and idiomatic way to say "consume and
ignore".  The statement's own value in perl is the RHS list.

FIX SHAPE (not designed â sizing note only): the shape is the SAME no-op
`_is_empty_my_decl` already handles, except the RHS must still be EVALUATED (it
can have side effects: `my (undef) = f();` must call f in LIST context).  So
either widen _is_empty_my_decl's sibling to "declares no variable" and lower the
statement as its RHS in list context with the result discarded, or let
_multi_decl return (\@vars = [], $has_init) and give _lower_block an arm for
zero names.  Check the second arm carefully: several places downstream assume
@$vars >= 1 (the `@$vars == 1 && _file_lex_renamed` branch, the has_init branch).

BAR: the three repro shapes + `my (undef) = f()` calls f exactly once in LIST
context + the mixed list (#570's rows) unchanged + `my ()` (task #227) unchanged;
Pl/ change so corpus-diff + emission-ab, and a gate-SET scan over both
populations because a REFUSAL stops firing (s372 rule); guard rows in
Pl/t/aassign-01.t beside the #570 family.


DONE s451y (Opus, round 10 agent Y), commit 81d212c.  One sibling predicate _is_no_name_my_decl beside _is_empty_my_decl plus one arm in _lower_block before the die: the statement lowers through the expression machinery unchanged (the same _lower_expr([@k], $stmt) the multi-decl branch runs), so the RHS is evaluated ONCE in LIST context and the scalar tail value is the RHS count.  22 probes vs perl; corpus-diff IDENTICAL over 111 and a 1007-file emission A/B SAME 1007 / DIFF 0 / RCDIFF 0, so the shape occurs in NO population and the guard rows are the bar (Pl/t/aassign-01.t 18 -> 24, inverse-run verified).  DO NOT RETRY: letting _multi_decl return an EMPTY name list (fix option (b) in the original text) was NOT taken -- four callers read its contract and several downstream branches assume @$vars >= 1.  Residue FILED as #721 (a list assignment used as a VALUE in LIST context returns the scalar count where perl returns the LHS lvalues -- family-wide, pre-existing).
